name: Rice bowl
intro: October's rice bowl is built on two things you made once: a tray of roasted kabocha and a jar of muhammara.
keep: Protein of choice (chicken, beef, beans, or nothing)

variations.context: The version you'll make most often. Three minutes if the tray is in the fridge.
Cold and hot, sweet and sour. No protein needed.
The filling one, for after a long day.

finish: Pomegranate last, over everything, so it stays cold and bright against the warm rice. If the bowl tastes flat, it wants salt or another spoonful of the jar.
